description: Infraspinatus fans across the back of the scapula, wrapping to the humerus to spin the arm outward and carve crisp shoulder shadows.
actions: Laterally rotates the humerus, opening the elbow outward in throws and reaches.
Helps depress and center the humeral head, safeguarding the shoulder joint during elevation.
Balances the deltoid during abduction, smoothing the back of the shoulder mass.
